file.description: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, MP4, or WebM. Image/video limits are configurable server-side.

csv.description: Inline CSV alternative when multipart upload is not used.

InventoryReservation.description: ATP reservation result; fields are the reservation allocation contract.

WriteResult.description: Stable write result fields. Endpoint-specific resource fields are listed by the controller/resource contract.

detail.description: Short reachability detail; never contains credentials.

certified.description: True when every configured provider is reachable; missing providers are not failures.

ProviderWebhookResult.description: Provider acknowledgement. Provider-specific response fields are intentionally not certified here.

UnknownData.description: Endpoint-specific success data not yet mapped by the generator. Consumers must treat this payload as opaque.
